text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, right before the Japan Cup—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Now, it's time for music.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Gathering across the seas are heroes who define their eras.
The melodies they play, the backgrounds they carry,
are all wonderfully diverse—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Let us unravel it all.
And keep your eyes wide open to witness it.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The music we perform—
The "Japan Cup"!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even at the Japan Cup, Sounds of Earth made zero compromises in building up the audience's anticipation right until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"So that every spectator can fully enjoy
the greatest race run by the greatest Umamusume—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And then, the day of the Japan Cup arrived.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text: —Oh, I get it! So the frontrunners of Earth's generation are all lining up for this one! Man, this is gonna be hype~!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black, and Cheval Grand who's rapidly
grown recently...! Clashing with them is gonna
be thrilling...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Looking at it again, this Japan Cup
has so many highlights! Races with Earth in them
are always great like that!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...I have to see it through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: On this stage that I was never able to stand on...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ah, what a catastrophe...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Nothing's coming to mind...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Words to express this love and passion burning hotter than the sun, scorching my very being even now!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
No words can do it justice...!
I can't even begin to express it...! Mamma mia...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems Sounds of Earth's spirits are running higher than ever with the race just around the corner...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It's only natural. This is the race she's spent all this time building up toward. In that case—
choice_data_list: ...All that's left is to have fun, right?
...All that's left is to have fun, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's better to just forget words altogether.
Let's just follow our feelings and go enjoy the race.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ......Yeah, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Let's just have fun.
In the greatest race ever.

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
――Ah, there you are.
I was waiting for you, Earth.

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
Look who's arrived—the star of the show.
Why don't we show them what we've got today?

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text: Witness the all-out run... of our "Resplendent, One-of-a-Kind Generation"!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Sì, indeed! Let us make this the best race ever!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Just one correction, though――

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I'm not the only star of the show. Everyone running today shares the spotlight equally!

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
"Oops—
That's right!"

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's just like Earth.
Well then, let's go have some fun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —We've been waiting for you, Earth-san.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to convey it today!
My... "melodia"!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ――……I accept the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: With a run that's truly mine, for you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Come, my dear performers.
I'm going to enjoy today to the fullest. So—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Forza, iniziamo la sessione!!
